title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 12: The Book

scenes.say: One night he opens the old notebook from Iraq.
scenes.visual: a worn notebook opened on a kitchen table at night, lamp light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: The letters. The prayers. The names.
scenes.visual: pages full of handwriting, a faded photograph tucked inside, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He starts writing it all down. Every corner. Every convoy.
scenes.visual: a man typing on a laptop late at night, coffee beside him, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Some chapters take a night. Some take a month.
scenes.visual: a desk covered in crumpled paper and notes, early morning, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Writing about Roddy is the hardest thing he's ever done.
scenes.visual: a hand pausing over a keyboard, a photo of two soldiers beside it, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He writes it anyway. Roddy deserves to be remembered right.
scenes.visual: a dog tag resting on a stack of printed pages, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He calls it Hoodlum Soldier. Because he was both.
scenes.visual: a printed manuscript with the title page lit by a desk lamp, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Nobody's waiting for it. No publisher. No deal.
scenes.visual: a man sitting alone at a desk at dawn, stack of pages beside him, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
a box of freshly printed books being opened, warm light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Holding that first copy, he finally feels the war end.
scenes.visual: a man's hands holding a new book, close up, golden light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Thirteen. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a book on a windowsill with the sun rising behind it, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 12 of 25: The Book. The true-story series from the book by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
